svg.aria-label: locklog: Claude Code asks when the PDF errors started on a staging profile. locklog_count shows the step at 14:02, locklog_patterns finds the new pattern with the email and the IP masked, and locklog_trace follows order 4812: all free and masked. The agent then asks locklog_unmask for the email. The locklog console, in its own account and container, shows the read-pii approval screen with the masked record and the span marked; the human answers n. The agent gets denied and carries on without the address; the audit records every call with pseudonyms only.
svg.title: locklog: your AI reads the logs, not the people in them
